# Load packages
```{r}
# Install specific versions
#install.packages("data.table")  # Will install latest version (1.16.4)
#install.packages("rlang")       # Will install latest version (1.1.4)

# Load these packages first
library(data.table)
library(rlang)
packageVersion("data.table")
packageVersion("rlang")


# Function to install and load packages 
package_install = function(package_list) {
  for (pkg in package_list) {
    if (!requireNamespace(pkg, quietly = TRUE)) {
      tryCatch({
        install.packages(pkg)
      }, error = function(e) {
        message(paste0("Could not install ", pkg, ": ", e))
      })
    }
    # Load the library
    library(pkg, character.only = TRUE)
  }
}

# List of packages
packages = c('tidyverse', 'haven', 'qgcomp', 'dplyr', 'ggplot2', 'moments', 
             'naniar', 'VIM', 'missForest', 'tidymodels', 'purrr', 'gridExtra', 
             'knitr', 'infotheo', 'igraph', 'ggraph', 'lubridate', 'zoo', 
             'ggridges', 'slider', 'stats', 'reshape2', 'broom', 'gridExtra',
             'modelsummary', 'sandwich', 'igraph', 'ggraph', 
             'arrow', 'rio', 'RCurl')

# Call the package_install function 
package_install(packages)
```


# Load Files

```{r}
dir_data = "./"
```


```{r}
# import the US data
file_cache = paste0(dir_data, "OxCGRT_US_latest.csv")
if (!file.exists(file_cache)) {
  us_url = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OxCGRT/USA-covid-policy/master/data/OxCGRT_US_latest.csv"
  csv = rio::import(file = us_url)
  # Save to cache
  rio::export(csv, file = file_cache)
} else {
  csv = read.csv(file_cache)
}

```

```{r}
# Data clean

## set as data table
df <- setDT(csv)

## lower case names
names(df) <- tolower(names(df))

## rename
setnames(df, "regionname", "state")

## convert date columns to date type
date_cols <- grep("^date", names(df), value = TRUE)
df[, (date_cols) := lapply(.SD, function(x) as.Date(as.character(x), "%Y%m%d")), .SDcols = date_cols]

```


```{r}
# Get stringency

## window 1
strigency_index_1 <- df[date >= as.Date("2020-03-15") & date <= as.Date("2020-06-30"),
                      .(stringency_march_15_june_30 = mean(stringencyindex)),
                      by = state]

## window 2
strigency_index_2 <- df[date >= as.Date("2020-03-22") & date <= as.Date("2020-05-23"),
                      .(stringency_march_22_may_23 = mean(stringencyindex)),
                      by = state]

## window 3
strigency_index_3 <- df[date >= as.Date("2020-04-12") & date <= as.Date("2020-05-23"),
                      .(stringency_april_12_may_23 = mean(stringencyindex)),
                      by = state]

## Merge
df_stringency <- merge(strigency_index_1, strigency_index_2, by = "state")
df_stringency <- merge(df_stringency, strigency_index_3, by = "state")

```


```{r}
# View
df_stringency
```


# Save
```{r}
## export as RData

# Save RData
# This code saves your RData

my_file = df_stringency

# Replace with THE NAME of the file you're going to store in the bucket (don't delete the quotation marks)
destination_filename = '2d_stringency_by_exposure.RData'

########################################################################
##
################# DON'T CHANGE FROM HERE ###############################
##
########################################################################

# store the data in current workspace
save(my_file, file = destination_filename)

# Get the bucket name
my_bucket = Sys.getenv('WORKSPACE_BUCKET')

# Copy the file from current workspace to the bucket
system(paste0("gsutil cp ./", destination_filename, " ", my_bucket, "/data/"), intern=T)

# Check if file is in the bucket
system(paste0("gsutil ls ", my_bucket, "/data/*.RData"), intern=T)

```
